name: Apex Networks
summary: Brisbane business/wholesale broadband + connectivity ISP (APEXN PTY LTD, ACN 113 804 569); founded 2005, traded as Apex Networks from 2006; acquired by Superloop c.2015.

events.details: APEXN PTY LTD ACN 113804569 registered 13 Apr 2005; business name Apex Networks 26 Jun 2006; founder Ryan Crouch. Self-described as a Brisbane-based wholesale/business-broadband ISP with a national footprint.

refs.label: APEXN PTY LTD ACN 113804569 — registered 13 Apr 2005

source: APEXnetworks (apexn.com.au) self-description: 'a Brisbane based ISP with a national footprint ... incorporated in 2006 to service niche requirements in Australian business broadband and connectivity'

events.details: Acquired by Superloop (~A$5.8m); APEXnetworks-branded site continued to c.2017, then apexn.com.au 301-redirected away (by Aug 2017).
source: apexn.com.au CDX: APEXnetworks content 200-OK through 2016-2017, then 301 redirect from 21 Aug 2017
